name: Card Printing
definition: A single printed instance of a card in a specific set, identified uniquely by uuid. One row of the cards table is one printing; the same card name can appear as many printings across different sets.
scope: Card-level analysis where the unit of counting is a printed card, as opposed to a distinct card identity or a set product.

name: Card Name
definition: The printed name that identifies a card independently of the set it was printed in; several printings share one card name.
scope: Identifying a card by name, for example when a question names a specific card.

name: Card Set
definition: A named card release or product with its own short code, size, release date and product type.
scope: Any analysis that groups printings by the product they were released in.

name: Card Translation
definition: A language-specific rendering of an individual card's name, rules text, flavor text and type line.
scope: Determining whether a specific card exists in a given language, and reading its localized name or type line.

name: Set Name Translation
definition: A language-specific rendering of a card set's own product title, not of the cards contained in it.
scope: Questions that ask for the name of a set in another language.
aliases: translation of the name of the set

name: Card Translation Language
definition: The language in which an individual card's translation is written.
scope: Filtering card translations by language.

name: Set Translation Language
definition: The language in which a card set's own name is translated.
scope: Filtering set-name translations by language.

name: Artist
definition: The illustrator credited on a printing.
scope: Grouping or filtering printings by the person credited with the artwork.

name: Format Legality Record
definition: One card's status in one play format; a card has a separate record for each format it has been evaluated for.
scope: Determining whether a card may be played in a given format.

name: Play Format
definition: A named constructed-play format governed by its own card legality list.
scope: Format-scoped legality questions.

name: Legality Status
definition: Whether a card is Legal, Banned or Restricted within a given format.
scope: Interpreting the legality value attached to a card and format pair.

name: Ruling
definition: An official clarification entry attached to a card, carrying a date and the card it clarifies.
scope: Counting or reading official rules clarifications for a card.

name: Ruling Count
definition: The number of ruling entries attached to a card; comparisons such as the card with the most ruling information are made on this count.
scope: Ranking cards by the volume of official rulings attached to them.

name: Border Color
definition: The color classification of the printed border of a card.
scope: Identifying border variants, including borderless printings.

name: Borderless Printing
definition: A printing whose border color is borderless, meaning the artwork extends to the card edge with no printed frame border.
scope: Counting or listing borderless variants.

name: Power
definition: The combat power characteristic of a creature card, recorded as text; a dedicated marker denotes infinite power and an absent value denotes that the card has no power characteristic.
scope: Filtering cards by power, including the infinite and unknown cases.

name: Card Color
definition: The color or colors of a card, expressed as a compact list of single-letter color codes; an absent value means the card has no color.
scope: Color-based filters such as black cards.

name: Card Type
definition: The type line classification of a card, covering its card types, supertypes and the originally printed type line.
scope: Type-based filters such as Artifact cards.

name: Card Subtype
definition: The subtype portion of a card's type line, refining the broader card type classification.
scope: Subtype-level filters and type-line listings.

name: Frame Version
definition: The visual frame design generation used by a printing.
scope: Frame-style based listing or grouping.

name: Promotional Printing
definition: A printing distributed as a promotion rather than through a normal retail product.
scope: Identifying promotional printings.

name: Story Spotlight Card
definition: A printing flagged as belonging to a set's Story Spotlight sequence.
scope: Story Spotlight specific counting.

name: Textless Printing
definition: A printing flagged as having no text box; this flag is independent of whether rules text happens to be stored for the row.
scope: Identifying printings that lack a text box.

name: Card Rules Text
definition: The rules text box content stored for a printing, used for content-based matching.
scope: Full-text style matching within a card's rules text.

name: Foil Purchase Availability
definition: Whether third-party purchase identifiers exist for a printing's foil and non-foil versions; the presence of both identifiers marks the printing as available in a foil version.
scope: Foil-related counting and filtering over the purchase identifier columns.

name: Base Set Size
definition: The number of cards in a set's base numbering, excluding additional or specially numbered cards.
scope: Comparing or thresholding sets by size.

name: Foreign-Only Set
definition: A set flagged as released only outside the United States.
scope: Availability-geography questions about a set and the printings inside it.
aliases: only available outside the United States

name: Printing Count
definition: The number of card printings, used as the numerator or denominator of coverage and share measures.
scope: Counting questions and percentage denominators over cards.

name: Printing Share (Percentage)
definition: A proportion obtained by dividing the count of printings satisfying a condition by a chosen printing population, expressed as a percentage.
scope: Percentage questions over cards.

name: Printing Availability Channel
definition: The distribution channels through which a printing was made available, such as paper, online play clients or digital platforms.
scope: Questions about where a printing was distributed.
